Bill.BriefDescription: Regulating fees for using an automated teller machine.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the imposition of fees related to the use ofautomated teller machines; and adding a new chapter to Title 19 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The owner of an automated teller machinemay charge an access fee or surcharge to a customer for the use of themachine. (2) An agreement to operate or share an automated teller machinemay not prohibit, limit, or restrict the right of the operator of theautomated teller machine from charging a customer with an access fee orsurcharge not otherwise prohibited under state or federal law. (3) For the purposes of this section, "automated teller machine" isdefined as set forth in RCW 19.174.020(3).
Section 1 of this act constitutes a newchapter in Title 19 RCW.
